dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual reduction in the 2D geometric width starting from the mid-dorsal region and narrowing toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A distinct convex bulge is visible on the right lateral margin in the mid-body section; the left lateral margin is obscured by shadow and water turbidity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity with high-frequency specular highlights along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters distributed across the dorsal surface, lacking defined boundaries.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the primary greyish pigmented areas and the brighter reflective dorsal highlights.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark circular aperture (blowhole) at the anterior; dark linear contrast mark located on the posterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible shadow-casting longitudinal depression along the central axis of the posterior half, indicating a pronounced dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark vertical marking or indentation is visible on the lower third of the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is a singular, high-contrast focal point with a defined dark interior relative to the surrounding integument.
